description: This file defines a Spark plugin for profiling, including classes for driver and executor plugins, with initialization and shutdown logic, and references to Spark internal profiling components.

classes.name: ProfilerPlugin
classes.description: Main Spark plugin class that provides driver and executor plugin instances.

classes.name: ProfilerDriverPlugin
classes.description: Driver-side plugin handling profiling initialization and shutdown.

classes.name: ProfilerExecutorPlugin
classes.description: Executor-side plugin handling profiling initialization and shutdown.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with SparkContext and PluginContext, starts profiling if enabled.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Stops the profiler and performs cleanup.
